summary: The open AI model ecosystem spans model repositories (hosting weights and artifacts for download) and developer-facing inference platforms (serving models via managed APIs). Hugging Face anchors the space as the dominant hub, crossing 3 million public models by August 2026, though download distribution is extremely skewed—roughly half of all models have under 200 downloads while the top 0.01% account for nearly half of all downloads. Inference-focused providers like Together AI, Fireworks AI, Replicate, and SiliconFlow compete on speed, price-per-token, and model breadth, while Ollama leads local/on-device deployment.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open repository and community hub for AI models, datasets, and demos (Spaces), plus hosted inference endpoints. Functions as the de facto home of open-source ML.
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public hosting and community use; Pro ($9/mo); Inference Endpoints and Inference Providers billed per-usage (compute/hour or per-token); Enterprise Hub custom pricing
features: Largest model and dataset registry with Git-based versioning
Spaces for hosting interactive demos (Gradio/Streamlit/Docker)
Transformers, Datasets, and Diffusers libraries
Inference Endpoints and routed Inference Providers API
Download stats, model cards, and leaderboards
Collaboration, PRs, and discussions on repos
platforms.best_for: Researchers, developers, and organizations needing the broadest selection of open models, datasets, and reproducible artifacts plus community collaboration.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A lightweight tool and local runtime for downloading and running open LLMs directly on personal machines or private servers, with a simple CLI and local API.
platforms.model_count: Hundreds of curated models/variants in its library (Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; runs on local hardware (no per-token cost); optional cloud offerings for larger models
features: One-command local model download and execution
Quantized GGUF models optimized for consumer GPUs/CPUs
OpenAI-compatible local REST API
Modelfile customization for prompts and parameters
Cross-platform (macOS, Linux, Windows)
Privacy-first offline inference
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally for prototyping, offline use, or cost-free experimentation.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running and sharing open models via API, with easy deployment of custom models using Cog containers. Strong focus on image, video, and multimodal generation.
platforms.model_count: Thousands of community and official models (broad multimodal coverage)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-use, billed by compute time (per-second of GPU/CPU usage) or per-output for some models; no subscription required
features: One-API-call access to open models across modalities
Cog framework for packaging and deploying custom models
Automatic scaling and serverless GPU execution
Strong catalog for image/video/audio generation (e.g., FLUX, SDXL)
Webhooks and streaming support
Shareable model pages and versioning
platforms.best_for: App developers and startups wanting to ship AI features (especially generative media) quickly without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference and fine-tuning cloud for open models, offering fast, scalable serverless and dedicated endpoints plus training infrastructure.
platforms.model_count: 200+ open models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, FLUX, embeddings, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for serverless inference; dedicated GPU instances billed hourly; fine-tuning priced per-token/compute
features: Optimized serverless inference with low latency
Dedicated endpoints and GPU clusters for training
Fine-tuning and custom model hosting
OpenAI-compatible API
Broad open-model catalog including large MoE models
Batch inference and embeddings support
platforms.best_for: Teams building production applications on open models that need speed, scalability, and fine-tuning in one platform.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A speed-optimized inference platform for open and fine-tuned models, emphasizing low latency, high throughput, and function calling for production workloads.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open and optimized models (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mixtral, vision, embeddings)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; on-demand dedicated GPU deployments billed per GPU-hour; fine-tuning charges
features: FireAttention engine for fast, efficient serving
OpenAI-compatible API with structured output and function calling
LoRA fine-tuning and custom model deployment
Multimodal and vision model support
Low-latency, high-throughput serving at scale
Compound/agentic workflow tooling
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing fast, cost-efficient production inference and fine-tuning of open models.

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: A developer-facing inference cloud (with strong presence in the China/APAC market) serving a wide range of open models, including many leading Chinese open releases, at competitive prices.
platforms.model_count: 100+ open models (DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi, FLUX, embeddings, and more)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing, generally low-cost; free credits for some models; dedicated deployment options
features: OpenAI-compatible inference API
Strong catalog of leading Chinese open models
Text, image, audio, and embedding model support
Low-cost, high-throughput serving
Fast onboarding with free tiers
Fine-tuning and dedicated instances
platforms.best_for: Developers (especially in Asia) who want affordable access to top open models, including the strong wave of Chinese large-parameter releases.

platforms.name: Groq
platforms.purpose: An ultra-low-latency inference platform using custom LPU hardware to serve open models at exceptional token-generation speeds via an API.
platforms.model_count: Dozens of curated open models (Llama, Qwen, Mixtral, Gemma, Whisper, etc.)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; free developer tier with rate limits; enterprise plans available
features: LPU hardware delivering industry-leading inference speed
OpenAI-compatible API
Very low latency for real-time and agentic apps
Speech-to-text (Whisper) support
Generous free tier for experimentation
platforms.best_for: Developers building latency-sensitive, real-time, or high-throughput applications on a curated set of open models.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: A unified API aggregator and router that provides access to hundreds of open and proprietary models from many providers through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
platforms.model_count: 300+ models routed across dozens of providers (open and closed)
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token passthrough pricing with small routing margin; credits-based, no subscription required
features: Single API for many model providers
Automatic fallback and provider routing by price/latency
OpenAI-compatible interface
Transparent per-model pricing comparison
Mix of open-weight and proprietary models
platforms.best_for: Developers who want flexible, provider-agnostic access to many models with easy switching and cost optimization.
